name: Gem
summary: All-in-one recruiting platform with AI sourcing.
description: Gem combines candidate sourcing, outreach sequences, talent CRM, ATS and analytics. Its AI finds and ranks profiles that match a role.

description_fr: Gem combine sourcing de candidats, séquences de prise de contact, CRM de talents, ATS et analyses. Son IA trouve et classe les profils correspondant à un poste.
